findings.finding: Watered-land mode is incomplete. Vegetable mode allows up to max_crops second-season crops instead of exactly one, and the rule baseline can combine rice with a second season.
findings.recommended_action: Introduce an exact-one second-season constraint tied to the vegetable mode, forbid all second-season area in rice mode, repair the rule baseline, extend check_schedule, and rerun Q1.

findings.finding: The formulation carries one sales variable q per plot-slot-crop, although the sales cap is crop-year aggregate.
findings.recommended_action: Use one normal-sales variable per year-crop and aggregate production coefficients directly. This removes roughly one third of continuous variables and many linking constraints.

findings.finding: z is created even when min_share is zero and crop-count/rotation structure may permit tighter formulations.
findings.recommended_action: Keep z only where required by rotation or management, fix impossible variables at construction, add symmetry breaking for identical plots, and provide the rule baseline as a MIP start if the solver interface supports it.
